label: Fill the tenant of every join row from its parent

precheck.sql:
SELECT to_regclass('"public"."ProductTag"') IS NOT NULL
   AND to_regclass('"public"."CategoryDepartment"') IS NOT NULL AS ok

execute.description: Drop the product tags whose product and tag disagree about the tenant
execute.sql:
DELETE FROM "public"."ProductTag" AS pt
USING "public"."Product" AS p, "public"."Tag" AS t
WHERE pt."productId" = p."id" AND pt."tagId" = t."id" AND p."tenantId" <> t."tenantId"

execute.description: Drop the category links whose category and department disagree about the tenant
execute.sql:
DELETE FROM "public"."CategoryDepartment" AS cd
USING "public"."Category" AS c, "public"."Department" AS d
WHERE cd."categoryId" = c."id" AND cd."departmentId" = d."id" AND c."tenantId" <> d."tenantId"

execute.description: Fill the tenant of every product tag from its product
execute.sql:
UPDATE "public"."ProductTag" AS pt
SET "tenantId" = p."tenantId"
FROM "public"."Product" AS p
WHERE pt."productId" = p."id" AND pt."tenantId" IS NULL

execute.description: Fill the tenant of every category link from its category
execute.sql:
UPDATE "public"."CategoryDepartment" AS cd
SET "tenantId" = c."tenantId"
FROM "public"."Category" AS c
WHERE cd."categoryId" = c."id" AND cd."tenantId" IS NULL

postcheck.description: Verify every join row carries the tenant of its parent
postcheck.sql:
SELECT NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM "public"."ProductTag" AS pt
  JOIN "public"."Product" AS p ON p."id" = pt."productId"
  WHERE pt."tenantId" IS DISTINCT FROM p."tenantId"
) AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM "public"."CategoryDepartment" AS cd
  JOIN "public"."Category" AS c ON c."id" = cd."categoryId"
  WHERE cd."tenantId" IS DISTINCT FROM c."tenantId"
) AS ok
